title: Spatio-temporal analysis of recorded cancer contact prevalence in EsSalud, Peru, 2019-2022: analysis code
description: R code for the construction of the analytical dataset, adjacency matrix, Bayesian spatio-temporal model (BYM with INLA), priors, model assessment, sensitivity analyses and the tables and figures of the article 'Geographical variation in cancer prevalence during and after COVID-19 in Peru based on the social health insurance system'.
